blocks.text: A Pakistani automotive manufacturer has opened up a manufacturing plant in the Philippines, it emerged on Friday. In a post on the social media platform X, the Pakistan embassy in the Southeast Asian country said: “Pakistan-made three-wheelers have entered the Philippine market!” It said that Philippine President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr inaugurated the assembly plant
